Name: Machiavelli's Ascent
Overview: Machiavelli's Ascent is a vertical platformer taking place in the deepest depths of the ocean. Guide Machiavelli the jellyfish on an ascending journey by consuming nutrient bubbles, chaining them together to create melodious combinations. Progress upwards with the catapulting assistance of jumpers and score enhancing starfish. Pursue and hunt elusives as you guide Machiavelli all the while earning achievements as you play and competing locally or globally for highscores. See you underwater...
